FAQ 
Questions 
 Does Veil work with Zoom and Teams? 
Yes. Veil works with any screen sharing app. Toggle it on from the menu bar or with four quick left-right mouse movements before you share your screen. Veil does not auto-detect meetings. 
 Is this the same as Veil-Focus on the App Store? 
No. Veil for Mac (veilformac.com) is a separate app distributed as a signed DMG. It is not the App Store app named "Veil-Focus & Screen Privacy." 
 How do I activate my license? 
After purchasing, you will receive a license key. Open Veil, go to Settings, and paste your key to activate. See the activation guide for details. 
 How much does Veil cost? 
Veil includes a free 3-day trial. After that, a lifetime license costs $7.90 and unlocks the app on one Mac. 
 Does Veil hide macOS notifications? 
No. Veil focuses on blurring inactive windows. Use macOS Focus or Do Not Disturb to hide notifications during calls.

Veil 
About 
What Veil is built to do on Mac 
Veil is a Mac screen privacy app for people who want to hide sensitive information during screen sharing. Keep one active window clear while background windows—containing private chats, documents, and confidential data—stay blurred. 
The core idea 
Veil is a Mac screen privacy app that centers on a simple interaction model: keep one chosen or frontmost app visible while other windows stay blurred. This protects sensitive information during screen sharing—reducing the chance that private chats, confidential documents, internal notes, and personal tabs are exposed during calls and recordings. 
Who Veil helps 
Mac users who present or screen share often and need to hide sensitive windows. 
Professionals who work with confidential information and share screens during meetings. 
Anyone who wants a lightweight screen privacy layer without rearranging their desktop. 
How Veil works 
Veil uses a manual menu-bar toggle —you decide when to turn screen privacy on and off. There is no AI, no OCR, and no automatic sensitive data detection. Veil simply blurs all background windows, keeping only your chosen app clear. The blur intensity is adjustable, and the overlay follows your focus as you switch apps.
